verdict.rationale: Raygun's error statuses are documented as a triage workflow for the Crash Reporting inbox. Errors can be marked Resolved, and they can be ignored with conditions: for a time period (effectively a snooze), for a number of occurrences, or by rule. The evidence never mentions assigning an owner, and it never says a resolved issue reopens automatically when it recurs; the deployment-tracking claim about spotting 'regressions' is not the same as an auto-reopen behavior. Missing for 10: owner assignment, documented automatic reopen of resolved issues on regression, independent hands-on corroboration.
